downgrade_not_available.title: Downgrade Not Available
downgrade_not_available.description: You cannot downgrade your plan at this moment because your current monthly membership is still active. When your billing cycle ends, instead of paying the next monthly invoice, you will be able to choose a lower plan. You will be notified when your membership payment is due, and at that time you can proceed with the downgrade.

confirm_downgrade.title: Confirm Plan Downgrade
confirm_downgrade.description: You are about to downgrade your current plan. This action will permanently remove your stored data, message balance, embeddings, and storage. You will need to reconnect your integrations and re-upload your information after the downgrade is completed. Please confirm that you understand the consequences before proceeding.

confirm_upgrade.title: Confirm Plan Upgrade
confirm_upgrade.description: You are about to upgrade your current membership. Your current plan will be cancelled immediately and a new invoice will be generated for the selected plan. Any remaining messages, embeddings, and storage from your current billing cycle will be lost. Once the new invoice is paid, your plan will be automatically upgraded and your new limits will be applied.
